name: Documentary Field Reference Set V4
visual_standard: present-day physical reality + observational camera + restrained editorial evidence
production_rules: The subject and physical action stay visible while editorial graphics are present.
Use current commercially plausible equipment and a real operating environment.
Do not use holograms, floating HUDs, decorative lasers, dominant neon or staged fog.
Editorial overlays locate, compare or prove; they never replace physical footage.
